units.function: Query-schema and embedded-PostgreSQL regression suite for company-wide issue, comment, document, artifact, Agent and project search.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure schema cases and real Drizzle/PostgreSQL fixtures drive the search service directly; pg_trgm is enabled explicitly and database tables are cleaned between cases.
units.keyDataModels: Company search query, ranked heterogeneous result, snippets/highlights, counts by type, issue facets, zero-result loosen suggestions and hidden/harness issue visibility.
units.lifecycle: Create isolated company records and searchable children, execute one search, assert ordering/projections/counts, then delete all fixture rows.
units.testAssessment: Strong behavior cases cover wildcard escaping, exact/phrase/token/fuzzy ranking, cross-field snippets, hidden and cross-company exclusion, filter-only search, facets, cross-type pagination and artifact projections. The focused run passed 2 pure validation tests while all 17 embedded-PostgreSQL tests were explicitly skipped after five database-start attempts; no database behavior is claimed as passing. Missing coverage includes CJK/Unicode segmentation, ACL/data-contract visibility, high-offset pages containing real artifacts, stable cursor behavior under concurrent writes, large-content/query-cost limits, untrusted preview URLs and query-plan budgets.
units.designRationale: Lock a rich command-palette search experience against the actual PostgreSQL query engine rather than mocks.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs similarly strong end-to-end search fixtures, including Chinese enterprise content, human/Agent authority and evidence/data-governance semantics.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the real-database, wildcard, cross-tenant, hidden-record, ranking and pagination fixtures as provider-neutral compatibility scenarios. Add Chinese tokenization/pinyin, Principal/DataContract matrices, confidential evidence, cursor consistency, resource budgets, lifecycle-restricted Agents, sanitized assets and failure/degraded-mode tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: The suite proves company predicates but never proves that the caller is an authorized accountable human/Agent or that each result is permitted by its data and responsibility contract.

units.function: Bulk literal/URL extraction from visible issue titles/descriptions, comments and linked documents with source references and truncation.
units.dependencyDirection: The service directly owns Drizzle/PostgreSQL predicates, custom URL parsing, content scanning, English presentation labels and shared response DTOs; callers supply only companyId and query.
units.keyDataModels: Extract source, issue-grouped match, source reference, excerpt, query filters and paged/truncated response.
units.lifecycle: SQL-prefilter visible company issues, page candidates, batch-load matching comments/documents, rescan full text in JavaScript, deduplicate values, create excerpts and return grouped matches.
units.testAssessment: Source and tests show bounded result/match counts, stable updatedAt/id paging and strong same-company joins. Database behavior was skipped on this host. No tests cover provenance loss from deduplication, content/query resource budgets, CJK, ACL/data contracts, unsafe output rendering or concurrent paging.
units.designRationale: Use SQL to narrow candidates and deterministic in-process parsing to return exact values rather than database match fragments.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs evidence extraction for governed Agent and FDE workflows, but every occurrence must retain source principal, data authorization, classification and immutable query/result evidence.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as an EvidenceQuery application service over SearchIndex/DataConnector ports. Bind a verified Principal and DataContract, retain every provenance occurrence, enforce byte/CPU/result budgets, return stable codes/digests and support locale-specific extractors. ADAPT SQL parameterization, same-company joins, batch child loading, stable ordering and explicit truncation semantics.
units.responsibilityConflict: Identical values from multiple sources are collapsed first-wins, erasing corroborating or conflicting evidence provenance. The service has no requesting Principal, approval, data-owner contract or immutable extraction record.

units.function: Company-wide interactive search and filter/facet projection over issues, comments, documents, Paperclip artifacts, Agents and projects.
units.dependencyDirection: A 1,340-line service couples shared UI DTOs and routes to PostgreSQL-specific ranking/CTEs/extensions, most search tables, artifact taxonomy/service, extraction service and in-process cross-type merge/pagination.
units.keyDataModels: Search query/scope/sort, heterogeneous result and snippet/highlight, issue summary, artifact summary, type counts, filter facets, zero-result loosen suggestions and internal ranking fields.
units.lifecycle: Normalize/tokenize; construct phrase/token/fuzzy and comment/document match CTEs; materialize visible company issues; UNION results/counts/facets; enrich snippets; concurrently query artifacts/Agents/projects and counts; merge/sort/page in memory; optionally issue many loosen-count queries.
units.testAssessment: The suite is strong on wildcard escaping, ranking and tenant/hidden-record predicates but database cases were skipped on this host. Source proves uncaught gaps: no Principal/data ACL, English-only fuzzy word splitting, independently capped artifact page retrieval, large query fan-out, unvalidated preview-image URLs, Agent lifecycle visibility and no cost-aware admission.
units.designRationale: Deliver one rich command-palette response with ranking, snippets, heterogeneous counts, facets and recovery suggestions while using PostgreSQL indexes and avoiding row-level N+1 queries.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a governed Chinese-first enterprise search plane over organizations, humans, Agents, responsibilities, tasks, approvals, evidence and authorized data, portable across cloud and local deployment profiles.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT behind SearchQuery/SearchIndex ports with verified Principal and data-policy predicates, neutral typed projections, cursor/snapshot pagination, stable codes, query-cost budgets, Chinese segmentation/pinyin and pluggable local/cloud index adapters. Keep PostgreSQL as one small/self-hosted adapter. ADAPT parameterized LIKE/array helpers, visible/same-company predicates, materialized match-set concept, batch snippet enrichment, deterministic ties and wildcard/tenant regression fixtures.
units.responsibilityConflict: The service can reveal human assignee IDs, Agent capabilities and evidence-derived snippets based solely on companyId. It neither records who searched nor proves result-level authority, data contract, purpose, approval or query/result digest.

All matching Agents are searched without a lifecycle/status visibility condition, potentially exposing terminated or otherwise restricted worker metadata.
